extension.description: Confluence-jjs preserves the simple and direct Confluence interface while extending it with scalable front and back artwork, a song popup with track selection, synchronized lyrics and credits, configurable playback information, fonts and colors, an integrated Menu Editor, settings backup and restore, and selectable Confluence-jjs and Standard Confluence modes. Based on Confluence by Jezz_X / Team Kodi.

Confluence-jjs preserves the simple and direct Confluence interface while extending it with scalable front and back artwork, a song popup with track selection, synchronized lyrics and credits, configurable playback information, fonts and colors, an integrated Menu Editor, settings backup and restore, and selectable Confluence-jjs and Standard Confluence modes. Based on Confluence by Jezz_X / Team Kodi.

Confluence-jjs bewahrt die einfache und direkte Bedienung von Confluence und erweitert sie um skalierbare Front- und Backcover, ein Song-Popup mit Titelauswahl, synchronisierte Liedtexte und Credits, konfigurierbare Wiedergabeinformationen, Schriften und Farben, einen integrierten Menu Editor, Backup und Restore der Skin-Einstellungen sowie umschaltbare Confluence-jjs- und Standard-Confluence-Modi. Basiert auf Confluence von Jezz_X / Team Kodi.
